name: Agentic React + shadcn/ui
summary: Agent-testable SaaS starter: Next.js 16, shadcn/ui and Neon Postgres, with an accessibility-tree e2e harness.
description: A GitHub template for building agent-testable SaaS apps on standard Next.js 16 + shadcn/ui + Neon Postgres — nothing forked or patched. Its value-add is a semantic contract of seven ARIA rules, thin wrapper components that fix ARIA gaps (DataTable, Pagination, Breadcrumb, Loading, ErrorDisplay, IconButton, SearchableSelect), 14 toggleable accessibility traps, and a dual-layer test harness where agent-browser e2e tests check both the visual and the semantic layer.
contains: Next.js 16 App Router, shadcn/ui (Radix), Tailwind v4, TypeScript strict
Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM and NextAuth v5 credentials
7 semantic contract rules, with ESLint jsx-a11y strict
agent wrappers adding ARIA to DataTable, Pagination, Breadcrumb, Loading, ErrorDisplay, IconButton, SearchableSelect
14 intentional accessibility traps toggled by NEXTPUBLICTRAPSENABLED
agent-browser e2e harness checking visual and semantic layers
Vitest unit tests; test mode disables animations
hydration signal so agent tests can wait for React hydration
